_comment: Dial-check golden fixtures (quota-model 50 §1.6, §5.1). Generated; both evaluators read this file: the brain (test_exporter.py DialCheckGolden) and the proxy (dialcheck_test.go). Times are epoch seconds; `until` is a time, "until_paid" or null. `ledger` is the /preferred ledger block's period, as_of and per-pot spend (null: none read).
